# Popover

Popover is a component of `@kozmos-ds/react` whose docs do not describe it yet.

- **Import:** `import { Popover, PopoverArrow, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "@kozmos-ds/react";`
- **Group:** Overlay
- **Platforms:** React, SwiftUI and Compose; linked to its Figma component through Code Connect.
- **Storybook:** <https://vodoco.github.io/kozmos-design-system/storybook/?path=/docs/overlay-popover--docs>

## Example

From its `Default` story.

```tsx
import {
  Button,
  Popover,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverTrigger,
  ThemeProvider,
} from "@kozmos-ds/react";

export function PopoverExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider defaultTheme="light">
      <Popover>
        <PopoverTrigger asChild>
          <Button variant="outline">Open popover</Button>
        </PopoverTrigger>
        <PopoverContent className="w-80">
          <div className="grid gap-4">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h4 className="font-medium leading-none">Dimensions</h4>
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Set the dimensions for the layer.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </PopoverContent>
      </Popover>
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```

## PopoverContent

It forwards its ref to `HTMLDivElement`. Its props are `Omit<PopoverPrimitive.PopoverContentProps & React.RefAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "ref"> & { portalContainer?: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof PopoverPrimitive.Portal>["container"] }`.

- `portalContainer`: `React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof PopoverPrimitive.Portal>["container"]`, optional.
- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `forceMount`: `true`, optional.

  Used to force mounting when more control is needed. Useful when
  controlling animation with React animation libraries.

- `onEscapeKeyDown`: `(event: KeyboardEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the escape key is down.
  Can be prevented.

- `onPointerDownOutside`: `(event: PointerDownOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the a `pointerdown` event happens outside of the `DismissableLayer`.
  Can be prevented.

- `onFocusOutside`: `(event: FocusOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when the focus moves outside of the `DismissableLayer`.
  Can be prevented.

- `onInteractOutside`: `(event: PointerDownOutsideEvent | FocusOutsideEvent) => void`, optional.

  Event handler called when an interaction happens outside the `DismissableLayer`.
  Specifically, when a `pointerdown` event happens outside or focus moves outside of it.
  Can be prevented.

- `onOpenAutoFocus`: `FocusScopeProps['onMountAutoFocus']`, optional.

  Event handler called when auto-focusing on open.
  Can be prevented.

- `onCloseAutoFocus`: `FocusScopeProps['onUnmountAutoFocus']`, optional.

  Event handler called when auto-focusing on close.
  Can be prevented.

- `side`: `Side`, optional.
- `sideOffset`: `number`, optional, default `4`.

- `alignOffset`: `number`, optional.

## PopoverArrow

The pointer tying a popover to what opened it.

Radix ships it and this surface used to hide it, so a popover hanging centred
below its anchor had nothing connecting the two. Opt-in rather than baked
into `PopoverContent` the way `Tooltip` bakes its own: a tooltip is always
about the thing it points at, while plenty of popovers are panels that read
better square.

Defaults match `TooltipContent`'s arrow so the two agree on screen. Note it
inherits no border — `PopoverContent` is bordered and Radix's arrow is a
plain filled triangle, which is the same compromise `Tooltip` already makes.

It forwards its ref to `SVGSVGElement`. Its props are `Omit<PopoverPrimitive.PopoverArrowProps & React.RefAttributes<SVGSVGElement>, "ref">`.

- `asChild`: `boolean`, optional.
- `children`: `ReactNode`, optional.

It also takes the 473 attributes React's DOM types give it (`className`, `style`, `id`, `aria-*`, the event handlers among them).
